title: Evidence to Support Use of Ketamine in Treatment Course for Severe Depression in Singapore
what_it_is: Evidence to Support Use of Ketamine in Treatment Course for Severe Depression in Singapore

sections.label: Ketamine nasal spray depression safeguards
sections.summary: Ketamine nasal spray, given with oral antidepressants, improves major depression with mild side effects and is controlled, hospital-only, psychiatrist-prescribed and monitored.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Health (a) what evidence supports the efficacy and safety of ketamine as treatment for severe depression compared to other therapies; (b) whether there are plans to monitor long-term outcomes for patients using this treatment; and (c) what regulatory frameworks will be put in place to govern the distribution and use of ketamine for medical purpose while ensuring tight control to prevent diversion for recreational use.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: It is to be administered together with other oral anti-depressant therapy for the treatment of depression.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Clinical trials have demonstrated that the use of ketamine nasal spray resulted in improvements in symptoms of major depression with mild side effects and minimal addictive potential.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Overall, the benefits of ketamine nasal spray outweigh its risks.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: There are several safeguards in place to ensure the safe use of ketamine for severe depression.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: It is classified as a controlled drug under the Misuse of Drugs Regulations, which means that the product must be kept under lock and key with stringent records of the product inventory.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Further, it can only be supplied to hospitals and clinics providing specialist services for psychiatry, and prescribed for use by a registered psychiatrist.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: It is administered strictly under nursing supervision with resuscitation equipment and doctors on standby.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Patients are continuously monitored during and after the treatment for adverse effects before they leave the clinical setting.

sections.label: Ketamine not substitute for treatments
sections.summary: Ketamine is not a substitute for other depression and psychiatric treatments and should be used only when other treatments are ineffective.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The use of ketamine is not a substitute for all the other treatments that are available for depression and other psychiatric treatment.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: It should only be used when indicated and for those situations where the other treatments are not effective.
